# webbpulse_workspace (Data Source)

One workspace, looked up by id or by name. Exactly one of `workspace_id` and `name` is set. The API has no name lookup route, so a lookup by name lists every workspace and filters in the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "webbpulse_workspace" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The workspace name to look up.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace id to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the workspace was created.
- `description` (String) The workspace description.
- `engine` (String) Which binary runs this workspace.
- `engine_version` (String) The engine version this workspace runs.
- `file_triggers_enabled` (Boolean) Whether uploads are filtered by changed paths.
- `run_role_account_id` (String) The account the run role resolved to on its last successful check.
- `run_role_arn` (String) The role the runner assumes for this workspace.
- `run_role_checked_at` (String) When the run role last answered an AssumeRole.
- `run_role_setup` (Attributes) Everything needed to build this workspace's run role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--run_role_setup))
- `speculative_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a pull request upload starts a plan only run.
- `trigger_patterns` (List of String) Glob patterns over repository paths that decide whether an upload starts a run.
- `updated_at` (String) When the workspace was last edited.
- `vcs_repo` (Attributes) The connected GitHub repository, or null when none is connected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vcs_repo))
- `working_directory` (String) The directory the engine runs in.

<a id="nestedatt--run_role_setup"></a>
### Nested Schema for `run_role_setup`

Read-Only:

- `external_id` (String) The workspace id, sent as `sts:ExternalId`.
- `principal_arn` (String) The first runner task role the trust policy has to name.
- `principal_arns` (List of String) Every runner task role, one per phase.
- `role_name` (String) The name the role has to carry.


<a id="nestedatt--vcs_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcs_repo`

Read-Only:

- `branch` (String) The branch whose pushes start runs.
- `identifier` (String) The repository as `owner/name`.
- `installation_id` (String) The GitHub App installation that covered the repository.
- `repository_id` (String) GitHub's id for the repository.
